newsitem.title: USA: Delta worker killed in accident at JFK.
newsitem.headline: Delta worker killed in accident at JFK.

text.p: A Delta Airlines employee was killed Thursday in an accident at Kennedy International Airport, an official said.

A spokesman for the Port Authority, which operates three airports in the New York City area, said the accident occurred at 6:51 p.m. EST and involved Delta Flight 82, an L1011 aircraft bound for France. The flight was delayed and the plane would take off at midnight, the spokesman said.
An airport source said the accident apparently occurred on the runway when the plane was taking off.
